answers.core:
It does not add new functionality, but slightly modifies the functionality of an existing feature.
There are many 3D games made in Godot that make use of pixelated textures as a stylistic choice. The ease of making materials for these games can be significantly improved with a feature to allow multiple texture filtering options on the same material.
answers.workaround: It's not possible to work around this while keeping the functionality of StandardMaterial3D. After converting to shader code, iteration on the material is tens to hundreds of times slower.

title: Add second configurable sampling properties to UV2 in StandardMaterial3D and ORMMaterial3D
